National Film Awards 2026 Announce Acting Honours

The 72nd National Film Awards have announced their winners, with top acting honours being a significant focus. Kartik Aaryan and Mammootty shared the Best Actor award. Yami Gautam also received a leading acting award, while Randeep Hooda was recognized for his role in 'Swatantra Veer Savarkar'.
